name: toolbelt
description: The one front door: route any read/write/change to the right tool in this belt, run the doctor, and walk the user through fixes
surface: router skill + `toolbelt setup toolbelt` (hooks, detect-secrets, skill symlink, offered read-tier permission profile)

install.description: Turn on the repo's pre-commit secrets gate for this clone
install.why: If your git host disables push protection, this hook is the only gate you control between a pasted token and a commit that lives forever in history.
install.yes: git runs .githooks/pre-commit before every commit in THIS clone (no other repo is affected); a commit carrying a secret-shaped value is refused and tells you which line
install.no: commits in this clone are unscanned; nothing else changes. The doctor keeps warning until it is set

install.description: Install the scanner the hook runs (detect-secrets, via pipx)
install.why: The hook refuses to commit rather than silently skip when the scanner is missing — a scan that does nothing reads as a pass.
install.yes: one pipx-managed CLI (detect-secrets, detect-secrets-hook) lands on your PATH; skipped if already there; no global pip, nothing system-wide
install.no: with the hook enabled, every commit in this clone fails until you install it yourself

install.description: Link the router skill into Claude Code (~/.claude/skills/toolbelt)
install.why: This is what makes 'set up my tools' or 'read me that record' route to the right tool and its contract instead of the agent improvising.
install.yes: a symlink ~/.claude/skills/toolbelt → this repo's skills/toolbelt; an existing real directory there is renamed with a .pre-toolbelt suffix, never deleted
install.no: the skill is not available in Claude Code; the belt still works by hand (bin/toolbelt …)

install.description: Offer (never impose) a read-only permission profile for Claude Code
install.why: Without it Claude Code asks before every read tool call; the profile is computed from the manifests so only read-tier tools stop prompting and never-tier tools are refused.
install.yes: you see the full rule list first and get a second, separate yes/no; nothing is written at this step
install.no: skipped entirely; Claude Code keeps prompting per call

checks.fix: Run: bin/toolbelt setup toolbelt   (or: git config core.hooksPath .githooks)
